semiconductor_relevance: High — Advantiv Technologies Europe GmbH supplies various semiconductor materials and components essential for wafer fabrication and thin film deposition.
summary: Advantiv Technologies Europe GmbH is a supplier of semiconductor materials, including various types of silicon wafers and deposition materials. They provide customized components and materials for the semiconductor industry, catering to a diverse range of clients from small institutes to large manufacturers.
capabilities: Supply of dummy, test, and prime silicon wafers from 1" to 12"
Provision of evaporation materials and sputtering targets including Ti, Al, Cr, Ag, SiO2, Al2O3
Manufacturing of customized piping and components for vacuum equipment

regional_presence.Europe: Advantiv Technologies Europe GmbH operates as a trusted partner in the European semiconductor market.
